content.short: Bitvavo is a regulated European exchange and one of the largest venues in the Netherlands.
content.description: Bitvavo is a Dutch exchange registered with the national regulator and among the largest retail crypto venues in the Netherlands and neighbouring markets. Its reserves place it among the larger balance holders on Hyperliquid. European exchanges operating under MiCA carry compliance overhead their offshore competitors avoid, which shapes both which assets they list and how quickly they support a new chain.
